preconditions.description: The number of rounds n must be between 1 and 10^9.

preconditions.expression: a1 + a2 + a3 == n and b1 + b2 + b3 == n
preconditions.description: The total counts of Alice's and Bob's moves must equal the number of rounds n.

preconditions.expression: 0 <= a1 <= n and 0 <= a2 <= n and 0 <= a3 <= n and 0 <= b1 <= n and 0 <= b2 <= n and 0 <= b3 <= n
preconditions.description: Each count of moves for Alice and Bob must be non-negative and not exceed n.

postconditions.description: The output must contain the minimum and maximum number of rounds Alice can win.
The minimum number of wins must be non-negative and not exceed the maximum number of wins.
